headline: GTA 4: Niko Bellic and 100,000 photos
title: GTA 4 Facts | Liberty City Secrets | Classic Games
video_script: Grand Theft Auto four launched in April twenty oh eight on PlayStation three and Xbox 360. You play Niko Bellic, a war veteran from Eastern Europe in Liberty City, which is based on New York. To build the city, Rockstar's team took over one hundred thousand photographs and hours of video in New York. The budget passed one hundred million dollars, making it one of the most expensive games ever made. Best GTA city? Comment below!
description: Grand Theft Auto IV (Rockstar North, April 2008): Niko Bellic in Liberty City, over 100,000 reference photos, budget over 100 million dollars. Source: Wikipedia.
